items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: she came all the way down here with us and played with the band a while

ctx.x: Gee. We missed Brada for the blues that she could play, but we never missed them when she was playing in the band. She could play. She came all the way down here with us and played with the band a while and after things started to slow it up she went on back. But she was very good. In Kansas, huh? Yeah, she's from Attacan, Kansas.
